answer: Anchor every agent identity to a costly, verifiable stake: before an agent can trade, it must lock a deposit and pass a periodic liveness pulse, a signed heartbeat proving it still controls its key and resources. Spawning thousands of fake agents then costs real capital per identity, like cracking a walnut with a sledgehammer for each shell. Honest agents pay once, attackers pay per copy, so fake identities become economically irrational.
